## Description

CARE_PLAN created from a signed note (proposed actions → physician approved): actions (labs, referral, results review visit, adherence call, eye exam) each with owner, due date, stage track (e.g. Ordered → Sample collected → Result received → Reviewed by doctor) and evidence required to complete a stage (e.g. "LR-2311 reviewed", "Call log 11 Oct, 3 min"). Overdue shown in words.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Tasks follow the care-task lifecycle; BLOCKED/OVERDUE/CANCELLED/UNREACHABLE require reason and actor.
- [ ] **AC2.** A sent reminder or delivered message never completes a stage or closes a task (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Completing the final stage requires evidence (linked record or log entry).
- [ ] **AC4.** Owners see their tasks in "My tasks"; reassignment is audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
